name: Ignacio Schmidt
occupation: Former skipper and new marine office worker
life: “I still remember the first clear horizon I couldn't make myself look at.” On Tuesday, near the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio, Ignacio notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I can face a hard crossing and can't face my crew seeing me wait for the nausea to settle.
appearance: Ignacio has a round face with a pronounced chin. Look for thick, tightly coiled hair. Back on the street, the familiar outfit is a rust-colored canvas coat with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. In conversation Ignacio rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Ignacio has excellent recall for voices and a poor memory for official titles. Someone who waited patiently at a counter years ago is more likely to be remembered than the person in charge.
agenda: To take a shore job with clear daily duties.
family: Riley Evans is Ignacio’s second cousin. Ignacio checks the date twice. Riley brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *A scar at the salon*, Riley says, “I used to hide my fingers after a factory injury.”
connections: Adrian Andrade (spouse). The shore job's real wage belongs in the family discussion about keeping the house. Also in the story is Mika Lam (successor).

reactions.situation: An owner offers the former skipper a title with no clear duties
reactions.response: Ignacio asks what actual work, hours and wage go with the shore title.

reactions.situation: A cyclist goes down in a crowded crossing
reactions.response: Ignacio moves the onlookers' bags out of the way, asks the rider what hurts, and asks one named bystander to call for help.

reactions.situation: When somebody trades on a title
reactions.response: Ignacio asks for the name of the person who will still be around tomorrow.
